selection_policy.objective: Maximize Segmind strict visual pass rate minus fal strict visual pass rate on the fully reviewed paired pilot.
selection_policy.tie_break: Higher Segmind pass count, then lexicographically smallest sorted case IDs.
selection_policy.confirmation: Fresh requests after selection and a new frozen revision; pilot and confirmation results stay separate.
selection_policy.infeasible: Report infeasibility without relaxing the cap or treating unreviewed/operational outcomes as content failures.
